module: Physics telemetry tracker: reports physics instabilities with enough context to reproduce them ("physicsInstability" event: model, config, originating mod, level, simulation speed, vehicle count, position and sum of the vehicle's section damage) then requests the report to be written.
notes: This tracker only observes: it never sets instabilityHandled, so it does not interfere with whatever handles the instability.
If telemetry_vehicleInfo does not know the vehicle, nothing is sent.

onInstabilityDetected.desc: Hook called when a physics instability is detected on a vehicle: builds and sends the event, then calls telemetry_core.triggerReportWrite().

returnData.desc: Return table of the instability handlers (not used here).

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called on load: manual unload.
